**Problem**

_Describe what this change addresses. Link any related issue with `Closes #<number>`._

**Approach**

_Summarize how the change solves the problem. Call out anything non-obvious about the implementation._

**Type of Change**

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation or tooling only

**Testing**

_Describe how you verified the change. Include the relevant configuration._

 - Prebid Mobile SDK version: [e.g. 3.3.1]
 - Chartboost Monetization SDK version: [e.g. 9.14.0]
 - Ad format(s) exercised: [e.g. banner, interstitial, rewarded]

**Checklist**

- [ ] CI checks pass locally (`./gradlew ci`)
- [ ] Added or updated tests covering the change
- [ ] Updated documentation where behavior changed
- [ ] New files include the MIT license header
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or credentials committed
